source: Mostly captured from the StockSteps REAL backend public API (snapshot, news, quotes, profiles, daily charts, fundamentals, search). Synthetic sample values remain where the provider plan returned nothing: 1D intraday charts, sparklines, why-moving, LONGN and the older sample movers. Mock mode fills other gaps (missing quote fields, fundamentals, P/E history) with stable sample values; LONGN and TSLA keep their gaps to exercise missing-data states.
